lines.text: At Gethsemane, Jesus takes Peter, James, and John with Him and asks them to stay and keep watch.
Jesus falls to the ground and asks the Father to take the cup, yet wants the Father's will.
Jesus finds them sleeping and asks Andrew if he is asleep, then finds them sleeping again, their eyes heavy.
Judas arrives with a crowd armed with spears and shields, greets Jesus with "Rabbi!" and kisses Him.
Everyone deserted Jesus and fled, and a young man pulled free of his linen cloth and ran away naked.
